# Atelier Sans Titre

> Atelier Sans Titre is an event scenography studio in Beirut, Lebanon, founded in 2026 by Marc Azzi, architect and scenographer. Two sides: Private (weddings, engagements, private dinners, welcome drinks, after parties) and Brands (fashion shows; brand and corporate events including launches, activations, pop-ups, press days, window displays and visual merchandising; galas and cultural evenings). Lebanon first; the region when a project calls for it. Contact: hello@ateliersanstitre.com, WhatsApp +961 78 90 26 28.

## How we work
Concept, Design, Build. We design the place first: the way in, where people sit, the light as the night turns. Then we build it and run it on the night.

## Private
Weddings and private events: weddings and receptions, engagements, private dinners, birthdays, welcome drinks, after parties, zaffe entrances. Design first, then planning, then production.

## Brands
Fashion shows: runway, couture, presentations, showrooms. Brand and corporate events: launches, activations, pop-ups, press days, window displays and visual merchandising, retail environments. Galas and cultural evenings: corporate dinners, galas, vernissages and openings.

## Sectors
Fashion, jewellery, beauty, spirits, automotive, art and culture.

## Where
Lebanon first: Beirut, Mount Lebanon, the mountains and the coast. The region and Europe when a project calls for it, including weddings for Lebanese families marrying abroad.

## Note on imagery
Project imagery on this site is concept renders by Atelier Sans Titre, labelled as concept studies. No built-project photography is published yet.
